name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
title: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd - 513097 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue +12.3% to ₹570.9 cr and EBITDA margin 22.9%, but much of the contacts growth is silver pass-through and utilisation is only ~60%, so supply discipline is strong while volume is flat.

utilisation.quote: even today, even without that incremental capex, we are, at an average, we are still around 60%

capex.quote: there's no substantial capex required, but still, as we mentioned earlier also, we need some maintenance capex along with some automation capex, which is in the range of, 10 to 15 crore year-on-year
